title: California Insurance Code Section 10167 (default nonforfeiture benefit where the policy names none)
updateCadence: Amended only by legislation. The section credit on the official host at the time of access read Added by Stats. 1943, Ch. 955.
claims: Section 10167 provides that any policy to which Article 3a is applicable which does not contain a paid-up nonforfeiture benefit shall be construed as granting nonparticipating paid-up term insurance as a nonforfeiture benefit under subdivision (a) of Section 10160.
